description: Spring Boot starter that provides opinionated, consistent and configurable JSON error responses for REST APIs.
rules: Add the io.github.wimdeblauwe:error-handling-spring-boot-starter dependency; no extra configuration is needed to get started.
Configure behaviour with the error.handling.* properties in application.properties before writing custom code.
Use @ResponseErrorCode, @ResponseStatus and @ResponseErrorProperty on custom exceptions to control the error response.
Implement ApiExceptionHandler (or extend AbstractApiExceptionHandler) as a Spring bean only when properties and annotations are not sufficient.
Use ApiErrorResponseCustomizer to add properties to every error response.
